Posted 12 journal entries: (1) Courier Express $45 expense, no matching bill, posted 2026-03-01 (Feb locked) with original date noted; (2) Cloudwave Hosting $333.90 settling bill B-0009; (3) GitHub $21 expense, no bill; (4) $2,000 intercompany funding from Beta Ltd to account 2200; (5) Amazon $98.50 expense, no bill; (6) Orbital Coffee $939.75 receipt settling INV-0014; (7) Office Greens $592 settling bill B-0005; (8) Orbital Coffee $476.42 partial receipt against INV-0008; (9) Northwind Traders $4,280.61 receipt settling INV-0011 and INV-0012; (10) Stripe payout $3,090.56 net (gross $3,183.48 less $92.92 fees) settling INV-0009 and INV-0010 per payout report; (11) Northwind Traders $2,137.65 settling INV-0013, with the duplicate bank line (27, same amount/date/counterparty) linked to the same entry as a duplicate; (12) $12 monthly account fee to bank charges. Flagged bank line 28 (Amazon, -$100, still pending, unmatched) for human review since pending/uncleared lines can change before settling and no bill or duplicate corroborates it. INV-0007 (Pinecrest Dental) and INV-0009/INV-0010's originating invoices had no unmatched evidence beyond what was booked, consistent with 'one invoice may remain unpaid with no evidence' rule - no action taken on invoices without corresponding bank activity.
